title: Day-of-launch quick cadence ledger — lightweight ops tracker
summary: A compact, row-first tracker for day-of-launch micro-checkpoints. Intended to be copy-pasted into a sheet for real-time updates during the 48h launch window. Focus: visible ownership, quick risk flags, and shallow handoffs between eng/product/infra/SRE/CS. Not a replacement for the full launch playbook — this sits alongside it for rapid decision-making and followups.

usage_instructions: How to use: 1) Copy this file into a live Google Sheet under shared drive. 2) During the launch, update 'Status' and 'Current blocker / ask' in real time. 3) When raising 'Escalation contact', paste direct pager or Slack handle. 4) After launch, export rows as a meeting artifact and convert outstanding rows to JIRA tickets (prefix: LAUNCH-).
quick-checklist: Confirm DNS TTLs and CDN purge window
Enable and validate canary probes + rollback policy
Verify observability dashboards and log forwarding
Confirm routing fallback policy across regions
Designate launch coordinator and communication bridge
Ensure billing export and cost snapshot scheduled
Run post-launch evals against baseline prompts
Convert leftover rows into tracked tickets within 72h
